Yatrika
Family trips, planned by AI, led by locals
Pre-seed | Jaipur

Our team
Yatrika 3
Manish Joshi, Founder. 10 years running his family's travel agency in Jaipur, serving over 3,000
families.
Kavya Nair, Co-founder (Tech). 3 years as a web developer.
Our team has deep passion for travel and a strong love for technology. We believe in building with
heart.

Traction
Yatrika 4
In just 7 months we have served thousands of travellers across Rajasthan and Uttarakhand, with 3x
growth and many 5-star reviews.
We have built a strong brand in Jaipur and are growing across India.

The ask
Yatrika 5
We are raising funds to grow.
We will use the money for marketing, technology, hiring, expansion into new cities and building our
brand.

Our solution
Yatrika 6
Yatrika uses AI to plan complete family trips from Tier-2 cities, with vetted local guides, taxis and
stays, bookable in one place.
Families answer 6 questions and get an itinerary in 2 minutes. Trips are confirmed on WhatsApp.

Our vision
Yatrika 7
To become India's most loved family travel brand.

Market
Yatrika 8
INR 3 lakh Cr
Indian domestic tourism spend
Domestic travel is growing fast as Tier-2
families travel more. We are well placed
to capture this growth.

Our vision
Yatrika 9
To become India's most loved family travel brand.

The problem
Yatrika 10
Planning a family trip is stressful. Families in Tier-2 cities rely on relatives, agents and random
websites.
Prices are not clear, quality varies, and there is no one to call when things go wrong.
